task.title: Ignore one leading SSE byte-order mark
task.objective: Remove exactly one U+FEFF at decoded stream start across arbitrary input fragments
acceptance_criteria: One decoded or raw UTF-8 BOM at stream start is ignored
A raw BOM may span multiple parser feeds
U+FEFF after stream start is preserved

attempts.summary: Added regressions for fragmented raw leading BOM, decoded leading BOM, and later U+FEFF
attempts.diagnostic: The first event field retained the leading BOM and was not recognized

attempts.summary: Held stream-start state across incomplete raw BOM prefixes and removed one complete leading marker

outcome.summary: The SSE parser ignores one leading BOM without changing later text or existing fragmentation bounds

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1084

lessons: Stream-start decisions must remain pending while received bytes are still a valid prefix of a distinguished marker
Limit compatibility exceptions to an exact position and count so ordinary payload text remains lossless
